name: Supabase MCP Server
shortDescription: Manage Supabase projects, databases, Edge Functions, storage buckets, auth policies, and migrations.
longDescription: Official Supabase Model Context Protocol server enabling AI assistants to inspect Postgres tables, generate Edge Functions, review Row Level Security (RLS) policies, and query database instances directly.
author: supabase

envVars.name: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Supabase Personal Access Token from dashboard account settings.

tools.name: supabase_execute_sql
tools.description: Execute SQL statements on the Supabase database.

tools.name: supabase_list_tables
tools.description: List all tables, views, and schemas.

tools.name: supabase_get_rls_policies
tools.description: Inspect RLS policies and access rules.

tools.name: supabase_list_edge_functions
tools.description: List deployed Edge Functions and their status.
